en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a town square with a cobblestone street, several people (mostly children) standing in the foreground, and a central town hall building with a clock tower. The building bears ornate baroque details and a balcony, and is labeled as the city savings bank. Shops and houses line the left and right sides of the square. The printed title in ornate script at the top identifies the scene as the market and town hall of Wildruff. A printer's credit is visible at the bottom right.
